run_demo_gelsight_mini: run the demo script to connect to a GelsightMini tactile sensor and capture a frame
discover_gelsight_sensors: discover all Gelsight sensors connected to the host using gelsight.find()
connect_gelsight_mini: connect to a GelsightMini sensor by serial number and name using GelsightMini constructor
capture_gelsight_frame: capture a sensor frame from a connected GelsightMini using get_frame() and inspect its shape
show_gelsight_view: display the live view of a connected GelsightMini sensor using show_view()
